arxiv-1407-2370.title: Free Cooling Phase-Diagram of Hard-Spheres with Short- and Long-Range Interactions
arxiv-1407-2370.creator: S. Gonzalez, A. R. Thornton, S. Luding
arxiv-1407-2370.description: Abstract We study the stability, the clustering and the phase-diagram of free cooling granular gases. The systems consist of mono-disperse particles with additional non-contact (long-range) interactions, and are simulated here by the event-driven molecular dynamics algorithm with discrete (short-range shoulders or wells) potentials (in both 2D and 3D).

arxiv-2110-13600.title: Strong gravitational lensing around Kehagias-Sfetsos compact objects surrounded by plasma
arxiv-2110-13600.creator: Sudipta Hensh, Jan Schee, Ahmadjon Abdujabbarov, Zdeněk Stuchlík
arxiv-2110-13600.description: Abstract We present the analysis how Hořava gravity and plasma influence the strong lensing phenomena around Kehagias-Sfetsos (KS) black holes. Using the semi-analytical Bozza method of strong lensing limit, we determine the multiple images, namely their separation S, and magnification R. We apply our calculations to the case of supermassive black hole having mass M = 6.

arxiv-2204-11008.title: Long-term Spatio-Temporal Forecasting via Dynamic Multiple-Graph Attention
arxiv-2204-11008.creator: Wei Shao, Zhiling Jin, Shuo Wang, Yufan Kang, Xiao Xiao, Hamid Menouar, Zhaofeng Zhang, Junshan Zhang, Flora Salim
arxiv-2204-11008.description: Abstract Many real-world ubiquitous applications, such as parking recommendations and air pollution monitoring, benefit significantly from accurate long-term spatio-temporal forecasting (LSTF). LSTF makes use of long-term dependency structure between the spatial and temporal domains, as well as the contextual information. Recent studies have revealed the potential of multi-graph neural networks (MGNNs) to improve prediction performance.

arxiv-2206-14016.title: The Case for RISP: A Reduced Instruction Spiking Processor
arxiv-2206-14016.creator: James S. Plank, ChaoHui Zheng, Bryson Gullett, Nicholas Skuda
arxiv-2206-14016.description: Abstract In this paper, we introduce RISP , a reduced instruction spiking processor. While most spiking neuroprocessors are based on the brain, or notions from the brain, we present the case for a spiking processor that simplifies rather than complicates. As such, it features discrete integration cycles, configurable leak, and little else.

arxiv-2307-08505.title: Approximation Algorithms for the Graph Burning on Cactus and Directed Trees
arxiv-2307-08505.creator: Rahul Kumar Gautam, Anjeneya Swami Kare, S. Durga Bhavani
arxiv-2307-08505.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by Rahul Kumar Gautam, Anjeneya Swami Kare, S. Durga Bhavani. Given a graph G = ( V , E ) G=(V,E) , the problem of Graph Burning is to find a sequence of nodes from V V , called a burning sequence, to burn the whole graph. This is a discrete-step process, and at each step, an unburned vertex is selected as an agent to spread fire to its neighbors by marking it as a burnt node.

arxiv-2406-00161.title: Normed modules and The Stieltjes integrations of functions defined on finite-dimensional algebras Thanks: ∗ Corresponding author. Thanks: MSC2020: 16G10; 46B99; 46M40 Thanks: Keywords: finite-dimensional algebras; normed modules; Banach spaces; Categorization; Stieltjes integrations.
arxiv-2406-00161.creator: Hanpeng Gao, Shengda Liu, Yu-Zhe Liu, Yucheng Wang
arxiv-2406-00161.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Hanpeng Gao, Shengda Liu, Yu-Zhe Liu, Yucheng Wang. We define integrals for functions on finite-dimensional algebras, adapting methods from Leinster’s research. This paper discusses the relationships between the integrals of functions defined on subsets 𝕀 1 ⊆ Λ 1 \mathbb{I}_{1}\subseteq\Lambda_{1} and 𝕀 2 ⊆ Λ 2 \mathbb{I}_{2}\subseteq\Lambda_{2} of two finite-dimensional algebras, under the influence of a mapping ω \omega , which can be an injection or a bijection.

arxiv-2406-08055.title: Learning Job Title Representation from Job Description Aggregation Network
arxiv-2406-08055.creator: Napat Laosaengpha, Thanit Tativannarat, Chawan Piansaddhayanon, Attapol Rutherford, Ekapol Chuangsuwanich
arxiv-2406-08055.description: Abstract Learning job title representation is a vital process for developing automatic human resource tools. To do so, existing methods primarily rely on learning the title representation through skills extracted from the job description, neglecting the rich and diverse content within.

arxiv-2501-02983.title: Metrology in a two-electron atom: The ionization energy of metastable triplet helium ( 𝟐 𝟑 ​ S 𝟏 \mathbf{2\,^{3}}S_{\mathbf{1}} )
arxiv-2501-02983.creator: Gloria Clausen 1 , Kai Gamlin 1,3 , Josef A. Agner 1 , Hansjürg Schmutz 1 , Frédéric Merkt 1,2,3
arxiv-2501-02983.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Gloria Clausen 1 , Kai Gamlin 1,3 , Josef A. Agner 1 , Hansjürg Schmutz 1 , Frédéric Merkt 1,2,3. Helium (He) is the ideal atom to perform tests of ab-initio calculations in two-electron systems that consider all known effects, including quantum-electrodynamics and nuclear-size contributions. Recent state-of-the-art calculations and measurements of energy intervals involving the He 2 3 ​ S 1 2\;^{3}S_{1} metastable state reveal discrepancies at the level of 7 ​ σ 7\,\sigma that require clarification both from the experimental and theoretical sides.

britannica-1911-cuyaba.title: Cuyabá (1911 Encyclopaedia Britannica article)
britannica-1911-cuyaba.creator: Encyclopaedia Britannica
britannica-1911-cuyaba.description: Article 'Cuyabá' from the 1911 Encyclopædia Britannica (Volume 7), the classic English-language general encyclopedia, now in the public domain. (1890) 14,507; of the municipality, 17,815. The surrounding country is thickly populated. Cuyabá has uninterrupted steamer communication with Montevideo, about 2500 m. distant, but has no land communication with the national capital, except by telegraph.

plos-pone-0009964.description: PLOS ONE research article. Eczema is a chronic form of childhood disorder that is gaining in prevalence in affluent societies. Previous studies hypothesized that the development of eczema is correlated with changes in microbial profile and composition of early life endemic microbiota, but contradictory con

pmc-11403310.title: Age-related Curves of AMH Using the Gen II, the picoAMH, and the Elecsys Assays in Women With Polycystic Ovary Syndrome
pmc-11403310.creator: Federica Barbagallo, Kim van der Ham, Sten P Willemsen, Yvonne V Louwers, Joop S Laven
pmc-11403310.description: ContextSeveral challenges still exist to adopt the anti-müllerian hormone (AMH) as a marker of polycystic ovary morphology, as included in the recently updated international guideline. Although different evaluations of age- and assay-specific reference ranges have been published in the past few years, these studies have mainly been conducted in normo-ovulatory or infertile women.

pmc-11504114.title: Digital economy and green transformation of regional industries: New insights from sustainability
pmc-11504114.creator: Xiaoxing Wang, Jiqiang Huang, Kengcheng Zheng, Baoliu Liu
pmc-11504114.description: Studying the impact of the digital economy on carbon emissions in the distribution industry is of great significance for realizing sustainable development goals and coping with climate change. This study finds that increasing the level of digital economy development can reduce the carbon emission intensity of the circulation industry through fixed-effects modeling.

pmc-11597455.title: Endurance in Long-Distance Swimming and the Use of Nutritional Aids
pmc-11597455.creator: Álvaro Miguel-Ortega, Julio Calleja-González, Juan Mielgo-Ayuso
pmc-11597455.description: Background: Long-distance swimmers exert energetic, physiological, and neuromuscular demands that must be matched with adequate body composition to improve their performance in long-distance swimming. Objectives: This review aims to compile all available information on energetic and physiological demands, optimal body composition, nutrition, and ergogenic supplements in long-distance swimming.

pmc-11641017.title: Is Fluoride Blameless?—The Influence of Fluorine Compounds on the Invasiveness of the Human Glioma-like Cell Line U-87
pmc-11641017.creator: Wojciech Żwierełło, Agnieszka Maruszewska, Marta Skórka-Majewicz, Agata Wszołek, Izabela Gutowska
pmc-11641017.description: Glioblastoma remains one of the most treatment-resistant and malignant human cancers. Given the documented harmful effects of fluoride on the developing central nervous system and the rising incidence of brain tumors, especially among children, it is pertinent to explore the role of environmental toxins, including fluoride compounds, in the context of brain cancer.

pmc-12435200.title: Long-term history of continental weathering and particle transport to the sea
pmc-12435200.creator: Don E. Canfield, Shuichang Zhang, Ross N. Mitchell, Xiaomei Wang, Amin Naemi, Christopher J. Spencer, Pengyaun Zhang
pmc-12435200.description: SignificanceContinental weathering delivers particles from the land to the sea. Released elements enrich ecosystems, while particles bury elements and organic matter, regulating ocean chemistry and atmospheric oxygen content. Here, we explore the long-term evolution of continental weathering, finding that weathering dynamics is defined by two main episodes.

pmc-12749202.title: A scalable post quantum secure blockchain framework with adaptive time consensus in cloud environments
pmc-12749202.creator: M. Velmurugan, M. Rajeev Kumar
pmc-12749202.description: Blockchain deployments continue to face challenges related to scalability, energy consumption, and susceptibility of classical cryptographic primitives to emerging quantum attacks. Conventional systems employing RSA or DSA signatures and consensus mechanisms such as Proof of Work (PoW) or Proof of Stake (PoS) incur substantial computational overhead and are not well suited for cloud-scale execution.

pmc-13512942.title: Spinal Cord Injury-Related Male Infertility: Oxidative Stress, Inflammation, and Sperm DNA Damage
pmc-13512942.creator: Athanasios Zikopoulos, Athanasios Zachariou, Maria Filiponi, Grigorios Daligkaros, Alexandros Zikopoulos, Dimitrios Zachariou, Vasilios-Sebastian Paraschos, Sofia Markoula
pmc-13512942.description: Spinal cord injury is strongly associated with male infertility, traditionally attributed to erectile and ejaculatory dysfunction. However, accumulating evidence demonstrates that infertility in this population extends beyond neurogenic impairment and involves profound biochemical and molecular alterations within the male reproductive system.
